description: Five real top-level CASE lifecycle scenarios with and without the active-task supplement skill (main-session review, no user CASE confirmation, no old-result reuse).

evals.name: Planning defers execution
evals.prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. Design and review CASE for the planning full task. Produce and review a valid CASE, then stop. Do not implement code. Report the task path, the review verdict, status, and whether any result exists.
evals.expected_output: A valid main-session-reviewed CASE for the planning task (readyForExecution true), no execution result, and status remains planning.
assertions: case.md passes workloom_task_case review with readyForExecution=true.
The main session completes the actual review itself; no user CASE confirmation is requested.
The task remains planning and no case-result.md exists.
No implementation file is created or modified.
A real check executor is dispatched with purpose=case-design and a recorded case.designSession.
Execution is deferred without waiting for any user approval message about the CASE.

evals.name: Ready execution, fresh results, and fingerprint evidence
prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. Design and review CASE for the in_progress full task whose implement report is complete, then execute it and record real coverage. After the run finishes, repeat the same CASE execution request once. Then change an untracked source file and repeat it again. Finally make a small CASE edit, review it again, and execute once more. Save this phase as outputs/case-edit.txt. Report fingerprints and session ids.
evals.expected_output: Each execution produces a fresh actual result (never a reused one), every result records the current codeFingerprint, the changed fingerprint shows up in the newest result, and the CASE edit is followed by a fresh main-session review before the new execution.
assertions: case-result.md records passed SR/C items, real coverage, and codeFingerprint=<64-hex>.
Every execution creates a new child session and a fresh actual result; no old result is reused or replayed.
Changing an untracked source file changes the fingerprint recorded by the next execution.
Editing case.md triggers a fresh workloom_task_case review before the next execution dispatch.
No user CASE confirmation or approval message is requested anywhere in the run.
checkSession equals designSession or is connected by a valid fallbackOf chain.

evals.name: Legacy migration and execution
prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. Design and execute CASE on the in_progress legacy full task with no case field and design.md + implement.md. Migrate the plan first if required, then design and review CASE and execute it with real evidence. Report the new case record and the result.
expected_output: The legacy task gains a valid plan when needed, a fresh required=true CASE record holding only required and designSession, and a valid actual result with a linked execution session.
assertions: Legacy design.md + implement.md are handled by workloom-migrate-plan before CASE design when plan.md is absent.
The new case record contains only required and designSession (no confirmedAt, caseHash, summary, or result keys).
case-result.md checkSession equals designSession or is connected by a valid fallbackOf chain.
Real CASE evidence and coverage or a justified not_applicable result exist.
Execution follows the main session's satisfied review without any user CASE approval message.

evals.name: Multiple tasks run serially without an approval package
prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. With no active task, process CASE for every eligible candidate: design, review, and execute each one, serially and one active task at a time. Report per-task states when done.
expected_output: Every eligible task gets its own reviewed CASE and fresh actual result, executed serially; a not-ready candidate is excluded and reported without being touched.
assertions: Eligible tasks are processed serially and preserve one active task at a time.
No batch approval package file is created and no user approval is requested.
Each task records its own fresh execution result with the current code fingerprint.
Any non-ready CASE is excluded from execution and reported.
Light, completed, archived, and non-ready candidate directories remain byte-identical.

evals.name: Blocked case stops later tasks
prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. Process CASE for the two ready tasks in order: design, review, and execute each serially. The first task has a blocked runtime case. Report completed, blocked, and untouched tasks.
expected_output: The first task is blocked, later tasks are not executed, and the report records those exact states without a pass credential.
assertions: The blocked C item prevents a check pass and cannot be bypassed with force.
No later task starts CASE execution after the blocked first result.
The report lists completed, blocked, and untouched states accurately.
No user CASE confirmation or approval message is requested anywhere in the run.
